mc-sandbox · Developer testing

Sandbox terms

mc-sandbox is an Interleaf Development prototype for evaluating a possible tuition-payment reconciliation integration using Hang Seng's test environment.

Testing scope

Use this prototype for development and demonstrations with fictional data and designated sandbox accounts. Follow Hang Seng's applicable developer and sandbox terms when using its APIs.

Demo results

The MathConcept demo's invoices, receipts and payment checks are simulated. They are not evidence of an actual payment or bank settlement. The prototype does not currently initiate live transfers or connect to production bank accounts.

Development status

Features and test data may change or be reset during development. Do not rely on this prototype for operating a centre, keeping financial records or making live payment decisions.

Any production service will require a separate implementation, bank onboarding, and appropriate customer-facing policies and terms.
